name: root-kernel
description: Evidence-gated epic and task delivery, completed-epic validation, and development-tool setup workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Epic delivery, validation, and task workflows.
interface.longDescription: Root Kernel provides framework-agnostic development-tool setup, procedure-strengthened single-task delivery, sequential epic orchestration, and cold validation that remediates confirmed gaps in a completed epic.
defaultPrompt: Use $root-kernel:epic-handler to deliver one roadmap epic, $root-kernel:epic-validator to validate a completed epic, or $root-kernel:task-handler for one named task.
Use $root-kernel:dev-setup to diagnose and configure development tools for this repository.
